lastCommit.subject: Import design system; close specification gaps; decide stack

current.summary: Built the Flutter shell: theme, navigation, shared components, money formatting, 47 passing tests. Governing rule, given by the user mid-session: central theme-driven UI, nothing hardcoded per screen. Then swept README, CONTRIBUTING, sdlc-overview and design-system so no document still describes the repo as pre-build.
current.state: 29 specification documents plus a running Flutter shell; no product screens, no backend
decisions: Central theme-driven UI is the governing rule of lib/ - screens use plain Material widgets and app_theme.dart decides how they look
Bundle IBM Plex TTFs in app/assets/fonts rather than google_fonts - it fetches at runtime and the app must start on a bad connection
Two sibling StatefulShellRoutes, not one nested set - that is what makes a mode switch discard the other side's stack rather than suspend it
Push, lateral and replace get named methods in routing/navigation.dart rather than raw go/push calls at screens
Money is formatted only through Money / MoneyText - never at a call site, never from device locale; U+202F separator, U+2212 minus
Category hues reconverted from oklch(0.55 0.12 h) rather than eyeballed; two clip a channel at the gamut edge and that is recorded in the token comment
Placeholder screens take everything from the theme, so replacing one changes behaviour without changing the look
working: flutter analyze clean, flutter test green - 47 tests across money, both themes, navigation and components
App boots into the consumer shell; per-tab stacks survive switches, mode switch replaces the bar, wallet reachable only by push from the dashboard
Theme is genuinely central - no screen carries a colour or a size
Fonts bundled, so type is correct offline and on first run
CodeGraph current - its watcher indexed every file as it was written
notWorking: No product screens - every route renders PlaceholderScreen
Never run on a device or emulator; everything so far is flutter test
ThemeMode does not persist - resets to system each launch, needs the settings store

Serena cannot read Dart here until VS Code is relaunched - project.yml now says languages: [dart] but the MCP server caches config at startup; .serena/ and .codegraph/ are gitignored so the fix is local only
Eight design tables still lost to import truncation; 18 brand PNGs still only in the design project; hosting still unprovisioned
doNotRepeat: Bash heredocs for large Dart files - a ~350 line cat > file <<'EOF' failed to open the heredoc and bash choked on the first apostrophe; use the Write tool
Google Fonts CSS API for font files - it serves woff2 only, which Flutter cannot use; take TTFs from the IBM/plex GitHub releases (fonts/complete/ttf/)
Re-activating a Serena project to pick up a config change - returns success, keeps the cached config; needs a full VS Code relaunch
findsOneWidget on a pushed screen title - PlaceholderScreen renders its title twice (app bar and body); use findsWidgets
Decimal.signum is deprecated in decimal 3.x - use .sign, still an int
DesignSync get_file has a hard 256 KiB cap with no offset parameter
git add --dry-run output is filtered to nothing by the rtk hook - use git ls-files --others --exclude-standard
bc is not installed in this Git Bash environment
nextSteps: Relaunch VS Code so Serena picks up languages: [dart]
Run the app on a real handset - check type scale, nav bar, and that no motion loops
Build the first real screens: consumer Home, category browse, listing detail
Recover the eight truncated design tables, backRules especially, before building back behaviour
Take SSH from the user and provision the Oracle box - Postgres 16 + PostGIS, Redis, MinIO, Caddy, all arm64-native
Get a hosting quote from Digital Delta DC1 (BoFiNet, Block 8)
Remaining specs: offline and connectivity, API contract shape, environments and CI, observability
blockers: What the verified badge stands behind - StatusChip.verified renders the claim; what it means is undecided. Biggest single item.
LEDGER_ACCOUNT: one per provider or one per provider per category - blocks the ledger schema
Dispute window and full-trail retention are one decision, not two
The wallet naming contradicts a binding constraint in compliance.md - goes to counsel with the EPS question
What happens to already-accepted bookings when a category is revoked
Data residency - external, narrower: local Tier III capacity confirmed, only the price is missing
